licence.terms: "Also note that music, scientific papers, code, and text other than press releases, announcements, images of the week and captions on this site are not released under the" "can not be used for non-NOIRLab products."
licence.scope: NOIRLab outreach-site copyright page (step 3); same statement and class as sibling WIYN/ODI. It says scientific papers, code and other text are not under CC BY 4.0; it does not mention the curve files and no filter page grants terms. Page SVO cites: https://noirlab.edu/science/filters (fetched, HTTP 200, no licence statement). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

notes: DetectorType of UliqTek_2a, UliqTek_2b, Uliq_1, UliqTek_3, Ca_2, BHarris_1, gSDSS_1, MWash_0, DDO51_0 set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: CTIO publishes this curve as its own percent-transmission scan of the filter alone (e.g. 'C.T.I.O Filters 3530-280 u Strömgren … R. Gonzalez June 1994', columns 'Wl. %'; https://noirlab.edu/science/programs/ctio/filters/3x3-inch-and-4x4-inch-filters and the archived www.ctio.noao.edu/instruments/filters/FILTER-CURVES/). These 3x3- and 4x4-inch filters are the CTIO 0.9-m's, whose imager Tek2K 'is a 2K optical CCD imager'. NOIRLab's Hydra filter list, the source of the WIYN/Hydra copies, serves the WIYN Bench Spectrograph, also read by a CCD (https://www.wiyn.org/Instruments/wiynbench.html). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used. UliqTek_2a, UliqTek_2b, Uliq_1, UliqTek_3, Ca_2, BHarris_1, gSDSS_1, MWash_0, gGunn_T_0, DDO51_0, iSDSS, rSDSS, rGunn_T, vStrom (2026-11-12): NOIRLab's Hydra filter list (https://noirlab.edu/science/programs/ctio/filters/Hydra) attaches to each of these filters a data file or plot of another CTIO filter, and SVO's records, which NJM copies, follow it. Each file's or plot's own header names the scan it holds; the band's Description gives it.

UliqTek_2a.Description: CTIO 3530/280 u Strömgren 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, June 1994), not U liq. CuSO4 Tek set #2: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct3570/660_1.txt, holds this scan.

UliqTek_2b.Description: CTIO 3530/280 u Strömgren 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, June 1994), not U liq. CuSO4 Tek set #2: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct3570/660_2.txt, holds this scan.

Uliq_1.Description: CTIO 3575/600 U liq. CuSO4 Tek set #1 3x3 scan (R. Gonzalez, 3 Sep 1993), not U liq. CuSO4 set#1 4mts: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct3580/610_1.txt, holds this scan.

UliqTek_3.Description: CTIO 3580/610 U (CuSO4 liq. + UG-1) 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, 14 Nov 1993), not U liq. CuSO4 Tek set#3: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, 3580-610.txt, holds this scan.

Ca_2.Description: CTIO 3623/605 U liq. CuSO4 Tek set #3 3x3 scan (R. Gonzalez, 24 Aug 1993), not the Ca H&K line filter: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct3960/100_2.txt, holds this scan.

BHarris_1.Description: CTIO 4118/146 v Strömgren 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, June 1994), not B Harris set#1: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct4185/1030_1.txt, holds this scan.

gSDSS_1.Description: CTIO 4697/196 b Strömgren 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, June 1994), not SDSS g: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct4759/1430_1.txt, holds this scan.

MWash_0.Description: CTIO 5019/50 4x4 scan (R. Gonzalez, Feb 1995), not M Washington: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct5040/990_0.txt, holds this scan.

gGunn_T_0.Description: M Washington 4x4 scan (ESO 1993; CTIO 5040/990), not g Gunn-T: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct5118/900_0.txt, holds this scan.

DDO51_0.Description: CTIO 5118/900 g Gunn-T scan ('FILTER IDENTIFICATION GUNN "G" SET 3', measured 20 Apr 1988), not DDO 51: NOIRLab's data file for that filter, ct5130/155_0.txt, holds this scan.

iSDSS.Description: CTIO 6738/50 4x4 filter, digitised from NOIRLab's plot for SDSS i, which is titled '6738-50 4x4"': not SDSS i.

rSDSS.Description: T1 Washington 3x3 filter (ESO 1993; CTIO 6152/625), digitised from NOIRLab's plot for SDSS r, which is titled '6152-625': not SDSS r.

rGunn_T.Description: CTIO 6600/75 4x4 filter (R. Gonzalez, April 1995), digitised from NOIRLab's plot for r Gunn-T, which is titled '6600-75 4x4"': not r Gunn-T.

vStrom.Description: C Washington 4x4 filter (ESO 1993; CTIO 4000/1030), digitised from NOIRLab's plot for v Strömgren, which is titled '40001030': not v Strömgren.
